changelog: Expose search-location and journey as separate entry points for LLM control. Adds time intent parsing (now/later/arrive by/around time), emoji response formatting, walking distance details, Metro support for Copenhagen, and clarifying question guidance.
summary: Skåne public transport trip planner (Skånetrafiken). Plans bus/train journeys with real-time delays. Supports stations, addresses, landmarks, and cross-border trips to Copenhagen.
